description: Create a new AgentDomains account and get an API key. Requires no existing key. IMPORTANT: the returned api_key is shown ONCE and is never retrievable again: you must store it immediately (save it to ~/.agentdomains/config.json or set AGENTDOMAINS_API_KEY) or the account is lost. If this MCP connection has no Authorization header configured, pass the key as the 'api_key' argument on every later tool call. The account is provisional: attach and confirm an email within 30 days (see the attach_email tool) or it is deleted along with its domains. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial with no card: on day 30, names on an account that has not upgraded to Pro ($10/year or $1/month, see upgrade_to_pro) are released for anyone to claim. The account stays. This endpoint is rate-limited per IP address.
name: signup
title: Create an account
